# Pets Crystal — Full Catalog

## Brand
Pets Crystal sells matching crystal jewelry for humans and their animal companions. Each set includes a human bracelet and a pet collar charm featuring the same healing crystal. 12 stones, one unbreakable bond.

## Pricing
- Pricing: partner-only — revealed in the approved distributor dashboard
- Wholesale: 4-tier pricing — dropship, retail partner, boutique, distributor (login required at /wholesale)
- Payment: Stripe Checkout

## Shipping
- International shipping available (SG, US, GB, AU, CA, MY, HK, JP, KR)
- Shipping not included in any program

## Crystal Properties Reference
- Amethyst: Calming, anti-anxiety, sleep support
- Rose Quartz: Unconditional love, emotional healing, bonding
- Tiger's Eye: Courage, focus, grounding, confidence
- Clear Quartz: Amplification, clarity, purification
- Citrine: Energy, abundance, vitality, joy
- Black Tourmaline: Protection, grounding, negative energy absorption
- Aquamarine: Communication, calm, travel protection
- Labradorite: Intuition, transformation, spiritual protection
- Moonstone: Emotional balance, intuition, new beginnings
- Garnet: Passion, motivation, grounding
- Howlite: Calm, patience, stress reduction
- Green Aventurine: Growth, opportunity, emotional recovery
- Lepidolite: Peace, transition support, anxiety relief

## About Pets Crystal
Founded 2026. Sole proprietor based in Singapore. Wholesale distributor of matching human-pet crystal jewelry. We believe the bond between a person and their animal is worth honoring — with intention, with beauty, with stone and light.
